reported_backing.meaning: totalBackingSigned() value reported by the Accountant from _readL1Backing
reported_backing.checkpoint: after _readL1Backing sums supply.value without subtracting borrow.value

real_net_assets.meaning: real net BLP exposure of the Vault's L1 account (supply.value minus borrow.value)
real_net_assets.checkpoint: real net assets of the L1 account

borrow_value.meaning: 0x811 borrow.value of the Vault's L1 account
borrow_value.checkpoint: borrow leg of the BLP user state

surplus_computed.meaning: surplus() value the keeper computes from on-chain state before proposing yield

assumptions: The borrow leg is observable via 0x811 borrow.value and is the only adjustment between supply.value and real net assets.
surplus() is derived from totalBackingSigned() so the reported backing figure is the quantity the keeper consumes.
Units of supply.value, borrow.value and totalBackingSigned() are all USDC.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a concrete numeric X for the auto-borrow amount; borrow_value remains symbolic.
Report does not state the exact arithmetic linking surplus() to totalBackingSigned(); the equality is assumed, not reported.

limitations: Formalizes only impact_peg_solvency; principal displacement and unbacked-yield acceptance are separate passes.
The auto-borrow trigger is conditional; the plan encodes borrow_value > 0 as the active scenario rather than a concrete prior transaction.
Whether the keeper is buggy or rational is not resolved and is not encoded.
